description:
Bicep module templates used by DEVDEER.

This package is mainly for internal usage at DEVDEER. However most of the conventions are related to the suggestions in the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).

We also tried to provide much freedom by parametrize our modules a lot.
releaseNotes:
- BREAKING: Microsoft.App moved to 2025 version removing strings and not supported options.
- BREAKING: AKS component now requires VM sizes in parameters.
- BREAKING: Renamed skuSubTier to skuName in Web modules.
- BREAKING: Web modules now use resource type site config instead if custom types.
- BREAKING: Environment params for web apps with slots now have a new type called 'environmentVariable'.
- BREAKING: No additionalSlotSettings anymore on web apps because they are automatically determined from env vars.
- BREAKING: Container group module now can deploy several containers.
- Fixed bug for ping-webtest deployments.
- Fixed documentation on params for container registry.
- Key Vault uses resource ID as additional parameter for the role assignment GUID.
